name: lingo-os
description: Local-first language immersion OS for German, Spanish and Japanese

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && uv sync --project backend && npm install --prefix frontend --no-audit --no-fund && uv run --project backend lingo db migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "uv run --project backend python -m app.devserver" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && uv run --project backend lingo serve
scripts.test: uv run --project backend pytest -q backend/tests && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.phone: npm --prefix frontend run android:sync && npm --prefix frontend run android:open
